name: National Environment Agency

scam_info.sample: [ Scam Alert] We are aware of a scam involving the impersonation of NEA’s ePortal ( www.nea.gov.sg/e-services ). Individuals have received SMS urging them to pay fines through a phishing site that requests payment details.
scam_info.notes: Public web preview of Telegram channel 'NEA Singapore' (8.98K subscribers) filtered by q=scam: 4 dated scam posts 2024-01-09 (fake Facebook accounts using NEA/Clean and Green Singapore logos), 2024-11-16 (fake NEA ePortal fines SMS), 2025-06-30 (Climate Vouchers: 'The ONLY way to claim ... is through go.gov.sg/cv-claim'), 2025-10-27 (generic). No fake domains/handles named. CAVEAT: channel found via search; not linked from the nea.gov.sg homepage social footer (FB/IG/LinkedIn/TikTok/YouTube) - ownership by NEA is inferred, not verified on nea.gov.sg. t.me robots.txt 404.

notes: No scam page on nea.gov.sg: sitemap.xml is stale (446 URLs, all lastmod 2018-06-27; 'advisories' hits are dengue/haze/licensee advisories); /media/advisories redirects to /media/news (filterable, no scam category). Genuine e-payment entry point per NEA's own Telegram alert: www.nea.gov.sg/e-services (ePortal). Climate Vouchers claim only via go.gov.sg/cv-claim. SPF brand tag 'National Environment Agency (NEA)' (1 advisory; SPF sample scam domain nodequa.net, not visited).
